question.text: Following the crowd into a hot sector because 'everyone is buying' is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Herding = conforming to crowd decisions, even against own analysis. Amplifies bubbles. The Trap: Overconfidence is self-based; herding is crowd-based. Cross-Exam Context: Behavioural canon. Manager's Pro-Tip: Track fund flows as a contrarian signal — peak inflows often mark tops.
